summary: Iteration 3 frontend testing (public status page + related): 10/10 scenarios passed. Public status page loads without auth for /status/KK-2501-006 (Pending) and /status/KK-2501-001 (Picked Up), shows masked customer name (Rina M*****a) and masked phone (0812****2222), 4-step timeline, LUNAS badge, WhatsApp shop contact button, staff login link, and no sidebar/app layout. Invalid ticket shows 'Tiket Tidak Ditemukan' with WhatsApp contact CTA. Mobile 420x900 renders single-column. RepairDetail header exposes btn-wa-send, btn-open-invoice, btn-copy-status-link. Salin Link Status copies https://.../status/KK-2501-006 to clipboard (verified). Kirim WhatsApp href contains encoded status URL 'https%3A%2F%2F...%2Fstatus%2FKK-2501-006'. Invoice A4 shows 'Scan untuk cek status' caption with QR svg. Settings page exposes {status_url} placeholder in wa-template placeholder list.

issues: React hydration warning in console: <span> as child of <option> inside add-part-select. Not introduced by this iteration but should be cleaned up (remove x-source spans from <option>).

critical_code_review_comments: PublicStatus.jsx line 158: totals is only computed when repair exists (guarded), OK. But totals.paid could be greater than total (200000 vs 150000) — displayed 'Sisa Bayar Rp 0' via Math.max(0, balance) which is correct. Consider surfacing over-payment as 'Kelebihan bayar' rather than silently clamping.
